project: When the Guardians Can Be Acquired

metadata.title: When the Guardians Can Be Acquired: Joint Protection Across Concurrent and Renewable Authorizations
metadata.description: Publication-prepared theoretical research manuscript continuing the unpublished Guardians work family. For finite individually valid persistent proposals, qualified root-local conflict journals and bounded jointly usable exposure, proves an exact joint-certificate/solo-availability condition; derives h>kappa+k*r and an exposure-window specialization; gives an exact residual-conflict handoff and reproducible finite and signed-SQLite tests. Mathematical methods inherit invariant confluence, generalized quorum intersections and proactive security. Not Byzantine consensus, unrestricted concurrent liveness, physical root validation or a proof of AI subjecthood. Substantial ChatGPT assistance disclosed; not independently peer reviewed.
metadata.notes: First Zenodo deposit intended for the previously unpublished Guardians research family; EAC-v1 and EAC-v2 are preserved unpublished drafts. EAC-v3.0.0 is a scoped theoretical preprint, not externally peer reviewed; substantial ChatGPT contributions disclosed. No priority certificate, rights of AI or physical security claim.
